summary: Specifies new FTP commands for getting directory listings in a defined format and for restarting interrupted data transfers in STREAM mode. It also allows character sets other than US-ASCII and defines an optional virtual file storage structure. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Old file-sending commands were messy. These new ones give neat file lists computers can read and let a download pick up where it stopped, and they allow letters from other languages.

questions: how to resume an interrupted ftp transfer
